comment: Solar winds parameters received a slight enhancement last night due to a CME arrival from the 9th. The Earth is also still under weak influence from a southerly coronal hole which is keeping solar winds speeds above ambient levels. Another coronal hole high speed stream from the north of the solar disc is expected to arrive later in the first period. This is anticipated to cause some ACTIVE to STORM G1 geomagnetic conditions. A glancing blow from a CME that lifted from the Sun on the 13th may then impact Earth late during the second forecast period and into the third, although confidence is low.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
